**Unit Position:** 4 of 4 (Final unit of the chapter).

- U3: Safety of microbiome interventions & context-dependency of donor characteristics.

**Chapter Argument:** Gut microbiome modulates ICI efficacy/toxicity via taxonomy, metabolites, immune pathways. Evidence strength varies by cancer type, toxicity phenotype (colitis vs myocarditis), and intervention context. Observational evidence strongest for colitis; myocarditis limited by sample size. FMT benefits/risks depend on donor composition and ICI regimen. No Phase III RCT evidence yet.
